integration_issues.issue: After filling all required fields (email, card 4242...4242, expiry 12/30, CVC 123, name, address, city, ZIP, state, phone) and clicking Subscribe button, payment does not process and redirect back to app. Form stays on Stripe checkout page. integration_issues.details: Successfully confirmed main agent's discovery: Card payment fields ARE collapsed until clicking 'Card' radio button. After clicking Card radio and filling all fields with test data, Subscribe button click does not trigger payment processing or redirect. Possible causes: Stripe webhook configuration, 3D Secure challenge, CAPTCHA, or backend payment processing issue.

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Stripe hosted checkout payment submission not completing. After successfully filling all required fields (email, card, expiry, CVC, name, full address including city/ZIP/state, phone) and clicking Subscribe, the payment does not process and page stays on Stripe checkout. Tax calculation works (8.875% for NY), confirming address validation passed. Need to investigate: 1) Stripe webhook configuration and backend payment processing, 2) Check if 3D Secure or CAPTCHA challenge is required, 3) Verify Stripe test mode settings allow payment completion, 4) Check browser console and Stripe logs for errors. The Card radio expansion issue is CONFIRMED WORKING AS EXPECTED - fields expand after clicking Card radio button. PNG download feature is fully functional.
